tools.name: seo-content_tfidf-term-gap
tools.description: Find stemmed terms common among competitor pages but missing or under-used in a draft, ranked by TF-IDF gap. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/seo-content/tfidf-term-gap Keywords: when planning or reviewing page content, draft, competitors, language, minDocFrequency, limit, gaps, lowConfidence

tools.name: seo-content_brief-from-serp-texts
tools.description: Build a content brief from caller-supplied top-ranking HTML: common headings, word-count target, questions and recommended TF-IDF terms. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/seo-content/brief-from-serp-texts Keywords: when planning or reviewing page content, pages, language, minHeadingShare, term

tools.name: seo-content_readability-score
tools.description: Compute Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid, Gunning Fog, SMOG and Coleman-Liau from caller text. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/seo-content/readability-score Keywords: when planning or reviewing page content, text, language, counts, fleschReadingEase, fleschKincaidGrade, gunningFog, smog,

tools.name: seo-content_near-duplicate-detect
tools.description: Cluster near-duplicate pages with Jaccard similarity on token shingles and connected-component clustering. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/seo-content/near-duplicate-detect Keywords: when planning or reviewing page content, pages, shingleSize, threshold, pairs, clusters, singletons, excluded

tools.name: seo-content_internal-link-suggest
tools.description: Suggest internal links by unigram TF-IDF cosine similarity and extract exact or partial anchor text from target keywords. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/seo-content/internal-link-suggest Keywords: when planning or reviewing page content, pages, existingLinks, minSimilarity, maxPerSource, su

tools.name: seo-content_keyword-intent-classify
tools.description: Label keywords as navigational, transactional, commercial or informational from bundled English modifier rules and caller brands. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/seo-content/keyword-intent-classify Keywords: when planning or reviewing page content, keywords, brands, language, results, Rule-b

tools.name: seo-content_keyword-group-lexical
tools.description: Group keywords that share the same Porter2 stem signature, optionally merging groups by SERP URL overlap. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/seo-content/keyword-group-lexical Keywords: when planning or reviewing page content, keywords, serps, minSharedUrls, maxGroupSize, groups, ungrouped, Lexi

tools.name: seo-content_keyword-difficulty-estimate
tools.description: Estimate keyword difficulty as 100 × mean of capped log referring-domain scores from the caller-supplied top results. tools.name: seo-content_heading-outline-compare
tools.description: Compare a target H1–H6 outline with competitors and list common sections the target lacks. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/seo-content/heading-outline-compare Keywords: when planning or reviewing page content, target, competitors, minShare, targetOutline, missing, targetOnly, warnings, Headi

tools.name: seo-content_serp-snippet-preview
tools.description: Estimate title and meta description pixel widths with Liberation Sans advances and truncate at caller-chosen limits. tools.description: Flag pages whose clicks or impressions show a statistically significant decline with Mann-Kendall, Sen slope and windowed percent change. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/seo-content/content-decay-detect Keywords: when planning or reviewing page content, series, period, alpha, minDropPct, com

tools.description: Score a draft against required subtopics with synonym phrases, listing covered, partial and missing topics. tools.description: Summarise winners, losers, new/lost keywords, top-3/top-10 crossings and volatility between rank snapshots. tools.description: How to contact BRAINIAC.software support: email, page URL, what to include in a message, and what not to send. Free. Does not send email.
